Independent re-check by the QA agent for hunter expire76.

VERDICT pass -- the check that recorded this defect now passes, under the definition PINNED for this row. That pin was written by us rather than taken from the failing run, so this is not automatically the identical test; our reason is below, judge it.

WHAT THE FINGERPRINT IS: a SHA-256 of the claim's declared definition in claims.yaml -- the two documents compared, the extractor read from each, and the relation and its direction. It changes when any of those change and not when the wording of the question does; the check function is a loop over the claims and is not part of it. It is the pinned definition, which is not necessarily the one recorded at the failure. Why this row carries a pin, in our own words: Identity moved, the comparison did not. 8ec5b45 added floor to Pair.fingerprint; Pair.__init__ has read that key to decide which side states the minimum since the key was declared in 729e095 (2026-09-07 19:34). The pin this replaces was set 2026-09-07 21:45, after that, so here only the hash formula moved. Hashing today's claim with the pre-8ec5b45 formula reproduces the pinned sha256:7faa6c280a992da1b4ca50ae36c0142b byte for byte. run-20260910T045212Z-de93be7 (level V, full selector) passes at_least with llms_txt on the left: llms.txt says 21800, build-stats says 22349.
